notes: This reviewed catalog is an acceptance candidate, not account access, route approval, pricing, a paid canary, artifact-storage verification or provider-bill evidence.

Use the official Video Generation V2 API: POST /v2/video_generation and GET /v2/query/video_generation/{task_id}; CN base https://api.minimax.cn and global base https://api.minimax.io. H3-Context-IR returns an enhanced prompt only and is not the video-create endpoint.

The public subset is text-only T2V, image-reference I2V and video-reference V2V. Image and video modes use reference_image, reference_video and reference_audio roles with an explicit fixed ratio. They are not first/last-frame interpolation or an exact source-video preservation guarantee.

The provider first_frame and last_frame modes ignore a requested fixed ratio and use adaptive. They are not exposed by this fixed-ratio contract. The provider description mentions middle frames, but the published content role enum does not define a middle-frame field; no middle-frame support is claimed.

The provider reference limits are at most 9 images, 3 videos and 3 audio files, with at most 12 files in total. The frozen public schema has only per-type maxima: image mode safely allows 9/0/3 and video mode 6/3/3. The remaining combinations need a versioned total-media constraint; excess files must be rejected, not silently dropped.
Images: JPG/JPEG/PNG/WEBP/HEIC/HEIF; at most 30 MB each, width and height 256 through 5760 px, width/height 0.4 through 2.5. The product may accept a narrower verified asset-format subset.

Reference videos: MP4 or MOV, H.264/AVC or H.265/HEVC video and AAC or MP3 embedded audio; at most 50 MB each; each clip 2 through 15 seconds, combined video duration at most 15 seconds; dimensions 256 through 5760 px, ratio 0.4 through 2.5, frame rate 23.976 through 60 fps.

Reference audio: WAV or MP3, at most 15 MB each; each clip 2 through 15 seconds and combined audio duration at most 15 seconds. Audio-only reference generation is not represented by the existing public modes and is not exposed.

One nonempty prompt of at most 7000 characters is required. Output duration is an integer 4 through 15 seconds, resolution 768P or 2K, and fixed ratios 21:9, 16:9, 4:3, 1:1, 3:4 or 9:16. Public resolution identifiers are normalized to 768p and 2k.

The provider also accepts mm_file references and Base64 data URIs, but the adapter uses only server-validated asset URLs. Total provider request body must be at most 64 MB. Client metadata cannot add roles, URLs, model IDs, callbacks, watermarks or unsupported provider parameters.

H3 generates video with native audio; the official model repository documents 24 fps and 32 kHz stereo. The public artifact remains one verified MP4. There is no published generate_audio, seed, output_format or output-count field, and no separate audio artifact or audio toggle is exposed.

Successful tasks supply an expiring content.url directly; no legacy file_id exchange is needed. Query can refresh an expired URL while the task remains available within the documented seven-day query window. Store the verified artifact durably before final success.

The official API publishes no idempotency key, client task identity or signed callback-verification contract. Use authenticated polling; ambiguous POST outcomes must remain reconciliation-required without retry or failover. Provider request_id is diagnostic, not an idempotency guarantee.
This reviewed catalog is an acceptance candidate only. It does not prove account access, paid generation, artifact transfer, pricing, provider cost or route readiness.

The exact official model ID is MiniMax-H3-Max, a fast-generation variant using the same /v2/video_generation and /v2/query/video_generation/{task_id} protocol. CN base is https://api.minimax.cn and global base is https://api.minimax.io.

The current official API supports T2V and first/last-frame I2V, but no reference images, videos or audio, no middle frames and no 2K output. First/last-frame I2V uses adaptive ratio even when a fixed ratio is sent. Therefore this fixed-ratio public profile safely exposes text-only T2V and does not pretend to cover every upstream H3 Max feature.

One nonempty prompt of at most 7000 characters is required. Output duration is an integer 5 through 15 seconds, resolution 480P or 768P, and fixed T2V ratios 21:9, 16:9, 4:3, 1:1, 3:4 or 9:16. Four-second output is not supported. Public resolution identifiers are normalized to 480p and 768p.

The public result is one verified MP4 obtained from the expiring task.content.url. No separate output audio, audio toggle, seed, output_format, output-count or arbitrary metadata parameter is exposed. The H3 Max API does not separately specify a guaranteed audio sample rate or output codec.

Task lookup covers the last seven days; a new query can refresh an expired download URL. There is no published provider idempotency guarantee or authenticated callback-signature contract. Unknown POST outcomes must not retry or fail over, and output must be verified and stored before completion.
